articles.title: Fortnite's Sprite Spree Week: A Last-Chance Bonanza for Collectors
articles.summary: Fortnite is rolling out Sprite Spree Week from Aug. 15-19, with boosted spawn rates for Galaxy, Holo, Cube, and Gem sprites. Players also get a Lucky Sprite Locator, double sprite XP, and no sprite dust cost. It's a final push to complete your collection before Season 4.

articles.title: Swiatek Battles into Canadian Open Final, Calls Season Her 'Toughest'
articles.summary: Iga Swiatek overcame Elina Svitolina in three sets to reach her first WTA final in a year at the Canadian Open. She'll face Elena Rybakina, who also rallied from a set down. Swiatek called this season the toughest of her life, making the victory especially sweet.

articles.title: WIT Studio Teases New Attack on Titan Project: What Could It Be?
articles.summary: WIT Studio, the original animation studio behind Attack on Titan, has announced a mysterious new project reveal on Aug. 20. The cryptic post features Eren and friends, hinting at a 'special dinner.' Could it be a prequel or something else entirely?
